text: Entry Requirements 1) Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens, under the age of 35, with valid foreign passports, in good health physically and mentally; 2) Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC shall be met; 3) Applicants shall hold Senior High School Diploma; Provisional graduation certificate is acceptable upon application, while the official Senior High School Diploma shall be submitted prior to registration at ZCMU; 4) Language proficiency requirements:For Chinese taught programs, HSK4 certificate is required.
